replies.question: How do I rescue Lord British?
replies.text:
GUIDE
Full answer
Reach Avatar level 8 if possible; stock healing, resurrection magic, food, reagents, gems, and a permanent save.
Carry the Sceptre, Crown, Amulet, and Sandalwood Box. Follow Woolfe’s lead in Trinsic to Sindar for INFAMA, use it to enter Dungeon Shame, and descend to the Underworld.
Follow the path to the central Underworld. Use the Amulet to reveal Doom’s entrance and speak VERAMOCOR to enter.
Use the Sceptre to dispel ethereal walls and wear the Crown through magic-heavy rooms.
Find the hidden pit on the final level, step through Lord British’s mirror, and give him the Sandalwood Box.
Use the Orb of the Moons he releases to escape the collapsing dungeon.
Source: existing guide; extracted. guides/js/Ultima5.js — ultima5GrandQuestChapters objective=doom-rescue
